title: 3 hour Private Afternoon Boat Ride and Beach Excursion
includes: JBL Beach Bluetooth speaker $10. (Boat has a great sound system, the JBL is great to take to the beach) (not included)
Yeti Beach cooler and ice $20 (boat comes with a large cooler and ice but not removable to beach) (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a half day cruising the harbor on a private center console captained by a professional yacht captain. Stop at secluded island beaches for shark tooth hunting, shelling or just lay out on the beach. 

We pass by all the historic areas of the harbor and more. The perfect boat to see and do it all in style!

Add beach chairs, cabana, beach towels, beach cooler and JBL speaker, and make it a party on the beach (additional fees for each item).

Southern Charm can reach speeds of 30mph, in three hours we can cover a lot of ground and visit many parts of the harbor. Lunch at Shem Creeks many restaurants is an option along with a long stroll on Morris island with the hopes of finding that coveted 50 million year old Megalodon tooth! Its up to you what we do and our captain will take you there!

We provide, cooler with ice, soft drinks, bottled water, Bluetooth boat stereo, Emergency porto potty, and Rain ponchos just in case

You may bring any food or beverages onboard.
